poll_authentication.description: Check whether a user has confirmed an authentication request, and collect their API key once they have. Poll no faster than once every ten seconds. TVmaze hands the key over exactly once, so store it on the first success; polling again answers as expired. The key lands in this step's result and therefore in the run log: write it to a connection, not to a message or a sheet. Needs no credentials; this is how you obtain them.

username.description: The TVmaze username the key belongs to.
